mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 9.0% triggers a negative S&P 500 forward return signal over the next 20 trading days, reflecting investor concerns about labor market weakening.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises >0.5 percentage points in one month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns do not decline significantly (t-test p < 0.05) when UNRATE crosses above 9.0% in the same month.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent monthly declines in federal funds rates and quarterly growth in demand (GDPC1) create a positive feedback loop, amplifying equity valuation appreciation over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS falls >0.2% and GDPC1 rises >2% in the same month
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-month rolling window when both proxies move in predicted directions.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a sustained monthly rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 9.0% triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days, as investors anticipate prolonged economic slowdown.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises >0.1 percentage points in one month
failure_condition: 20-day returns do not decline significantly (t-test p < 0.05) when UNRATE crosses above 9.0% in the tightening regime.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous monthly increase in supply-side indicators (INDPRO) and decline in federal funds rates creates a positive equity return signal over the next 20 days by reducing discount rates on corporate earnings.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO rises >1% and FEDFUNDS falls >0.2% in the same month
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-month rolling window when both proxies move in predicted directions.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly decline in the CPI inflation index (CPIAUCSL) below 2.0% signals deflationary pressures, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate lower interest rate hikes.
failure_condition: 60-day returns not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) when CPIAUCSL declines below 2.0% over quarters.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden spike in monthly labor demand (PAYEMS) exceeding 140,000 workers triggers a negative S&P 500 return signal over the next 5 days, reflecting short-term market volatility from unexpected labor market expansion.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS exceeds 140,000 in the current month
failure_condition: 5-day returns do not decline significantly (t-test p < 0.05) when PAYEMS spikes above 140,000.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent monthly increases in demand (GDPC1) and labor demand (PAYEMS) above their 5% growth thresholds create a positive equity return signal over the next 20 days, indicating robust economic expansion.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 rises >5% and PAYEMS rises >5% in the same month
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-month rolling window when both proxies exceed growth thresholds.
